DIAGNOSIS READY: Subclinical Hypothyroidism (Euthyroid Sick Syndrome or Stress-Induced TSH Elevation)

Based on your normal inflammatory markers, normal iron/B12, and lack of classic hypothyroid symptoms like cold intolerance or weight gain despite an elevated TSH, this appears to be a transient or stress-induced elevation in TSH rather than active thyroid disease. The fatigue is likely multifactorial, driven by recent stress and mild anemia of chronic disease rather than a primary thyroid or autoimmune pathology. We will monitor your TSH and Free T4 in three months to see if it normalizes or progresses.
